name: resource-leak
task: Fix: the stock sync leaks a connection on every failed batch.
diff:
--- a/stocksync/sync.py
+++ b/stocksync/sync.py
@@ -20,9 +20,10 @@ def sync_batch(pool, rows):
     conn = pool.acquire()
-    for row in rows:
-        conn.execute(UPSERT, row)
-    pool.release(conn)
+    try:
+        for row in rows:
+            conn.execute(UPSERT, row)
+    except DatabaseError:
+        return False
+    pool.release(conn)
     return True

defect.why: the except branch returns before pool.release(conn), so a failed batch still leaks the connection; release in finally
